pages.lesson:
LESSON: PRAYERS ON SPECIAL OCCASIONS ISTISQAA ISTIKHARA

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Devotional Acts
Topic 4.1: Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why do Muslims perform prayers on special occasions?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. describe how swalatul Istisqaa and swalatul Istikhara are performed to earn Allah (S.W.T.)’s blessings
2. perform swalatul Istisqaa and swalatul Istikhara in the correct way

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. describe how swalatul Istisqaa and swalatul Istikhara are performed to earn Allah (S.W.T.)’s blessings
   In simple words: practise until you can describe how swalatul Istisqaa and swalatul Istikhara are performed to earn Allah (S.W.T.)’s blessings. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. perform swalatul Istisqaa and swalatul Istikhara in the correct way
   In simple words: practise until you can perform swalatul Istisqaa and swalatul Istikhara in the correct way. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara in the examples.
2. Explain Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara.
4. Show that you can: describe how swalatul Istisqaa and swalatul Istikhara are performed to earn Allah (S.W.T.)’s blessings

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Watch video clips/read on how swalatul Istisqaa and swalatul Istikhara are performed and make notes,
2. Self-efficacy: self-awareness skill enhanced as learners demonstrate the performance of swalatul Istisqaa and swalatul Istikhara.
3. Digital literacy: the skill of interacting with digital devices is enhanced as learners research on the significance of performing swalatul Istisqaa and swalatul Istikhara and present on PowerPoint.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. describe how swalatul Istisqaa and swalatul Istikhara are performed to earn Allah (S.W.T.)’s blessings
2. perform swalatul Istisqaa and swalatul Istikhara in the correct way

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
